pos_tagger: honeyeater_lemma_de 1.5.1 UPOS on every token, as the sentence stage assigns it (per-lemma majority; a multi-token unit is X)

units.counted: a compound replaces its member words (a compound is a word); a phrase or construction counts next to its member words
units.entry_field: unit (compound, phrase, construction) on multi-token unit entries

exclusions.rule: excluded keys and unit headwords made only of excluded words are dropped; lower ranks move up

junk.routing: 2+ flags dropped; 1 flag within review_top reviewed (corpora/review/<code>.tsv); proper nouns capitalised in >= propn_drop of running text dropped alone; accent merges applied to the counts

learnable_names.rule: every learnable name gets an entry (developer, 2026-11-02; frequer/names.py)
